_comment: DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 for full-parameter training of Qwen3-8B across 8 GPUs.
ZeRO-3 shards parameters, gradients and optimizer states across ranks,
which is what makes 8B trainable in bf16 without offloading. ZeRO-2 (see
deepspeed_zero2.json) shards only gradients and optimizer states and is
faster, but it needs the full parameter set on every rank.
'auto' values are filled in from the HuggingFace TrainingArguments, so
batch size and precision are set in the YAML config, never here - two
places to change one number is how they end up disagreeing.
